Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1697668 (Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target chembl_id. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
